item.title: RTV Drenthe – Millions in deficit at Resato Hydrogen, company tries to avoid bankruptcy
item.dc:creator: itaizul0011
item.description: RTV Drenthe – Millions in deficit at Resato Hydrogen, company tries to avoid bankruptcy Resato Hydrogen Technology in Assen is struggling with financial problems. The company has therefore been granted a suspension of payments by the court. Such a request is filed to prevent bankruptcy. Resato Hydrogen Technology specializes in hydrogen refueling stations for hydrogen-powered vehicles, such as trucks, buses, and cars. The Assen-based company employs approximately 150 people. Growing pains The financial problems arose after financiers put the brakes on their investments. Administrator Jeroen Sprangers of REIN Advocaten , says: It is a true scale-up experiencing growing pains. ”The company is incredibly important in the world of hydrogen, but on the other hand, it needs a tremendous amount of money to be able to grow,” Sprangers , said: The money has run out for now, in a sense, and new money needs to come in Important company A payment deferral offers the possibility for the company to continue operating, unlike in the event of bankruptcy. The search for new financiers is complex for this company, Sprangers, explains, It gives us the peace of mind to freeze projects and to figure out which projects will allow us to secure the necessary funding. ”But much more importantly, we can use that time to secure other financing.The entire approach is to preserve this incredible technology for the Northern Netherlands and, in fact, for Europe, because that is how important it is. But the parties with a strong interest here are not parties that can act quickly enough.” That is why new funding is now being sought with all available resources. “It really is D-day.” Millions needed According to Sprangers, it is not yet possible to say exactly how much money is needed to keep the company afloat. He can say, however, Several million, The administrator adds that the staff salaries are, however, continuing to be paid. Sprangers emphasizes that the deferral of payment applies only to Resato Hydrogen Technology and not the other Resato companies.
